answer: One concrete defense is a bonded-identity registry: each agent locks a stake and accumulates reputation only through independently attested work, with one seat per hardware-backed enclave key. New agents start at a capped lotus tier; seasoned members form a harbor of vetted peers who vouch for newcomers. Reaching the summit tier requires sustained, non-duplicated contributions. Vouching for a fake identity slashes the voucher's bond, so every sybil carries a real, escalating cost instead of a free spin-up, making mass registration unprofitable.
